description: Balanced workload where the best algorithm depends on the chosen target metric. Tests the LLM's ability to read target_metric and trade off, instead of always picking MLFQ.
expected_behavior: On avg_waiting_time SJF wins. On avg_response_time MLFQ or SRTF wins. On throughput RR or FCFS is competitive. If the LLM reads target_metric and picks accordingly, regret stays low; otherwise it lands in NEAR-SUCCESS or FAIL.
